Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner gathered correct birth years (Gus Van Sant 1952; Massimo Ceccherini 1965) but then misinterpreted “born later,” incorrectly comparing ages at film release and reversing the logic. “Born later” means a more recent birth year, so Lucignolo’s director (1965) was born later than My Own Private Idaho’s director (1952).
